_comment: Atlas Phase 5 outbound Telegram notifier policy. The inbound conversation gateway is native Hermes (operator-configured via `hermes gateway setup`); this file governs ONLY the outbound operational notifier. Credentials are resolved from the env files below in order (first hit wins) so the wizard-written ~/.hermes/.env is reused without duplicating secrets; the alert target chat id is the one value the operator supplies (their numeric Telegram id). Nothing here is committed with real values.

voice._comment: Alert voice maps (change: telegram-voice-overhaul). Canon is telegram/docs/voice.md section 2; a conformance test asserts every entry here exists in canon. Both maps are REQUIRED and fail closed: a missing or malformed map refuses the render, no code defaults. lexicon maps a concept to its one approved word (banned synonyms live in voice.md); gloss maps a jargon term to the one parenthetical gloss attached at first use in a message.

gloss.rank-pinned: the bar is the Nth largest demand share and moves with the distribution
gloss.q-mass: a quantile of the demand-share distribution
gloss.conviction-based: weighted by how long a position is held
gloss.beta: a share count in one root validator's basket; its TAO value is beta x fund value / all beta
gloss.basket: one root validator's escrowed fund of subnet alpha, fed by root dividends
gloss.basket index: the NAV-weighted average of all live baskets; a new fund starts on this line
gloss.display price: a basket's raw price divided by its baseline, so funds of any age compare
gloss.root weight vector: a root validator's chosen split of its dividends across subnets
gloss.destination share: one subnet's slice of all curated root dividends
gloss.stake-weighted: counted by how much root stake each validator holds
gloss.unweighted: counted one validator per vote, not by stake
gloss.curated root flow: root dividends being redirected by validator weight vectors
gloss.durability window: the wait before a bar crossing counts as settled
gloss.shadow: recorded and measured, deliberately not sent

repository_update._comment: Significance policy. Churn is DENY-BY-DEFAULT: only ranges whose changed paths are provably a subset of churn_dirs (and with no recorded spec_version change) are digested instead of paged; any unknown top-level directory escalates to significant. Digested churn is held durably and rides the next significant alert; the backstop flushes it as a standalone digest after digest_backstop_hours. The DISPLAY of a significant alert is governed separately by three OPTIONAL keys (code defaults apply when absent): area_map ({top-level-dir: "core"|"node"|"noise"} for the signal-vs-noise breakdown; any dir absent from the map is surfaced as a new/unclassified area, never hidden), pallet_map ({pallet-name: domain-label} so a pallets/<name> touch is named and interpreted), and light_touch_ratio (0..1, default 0.15; when core-protocol line churn is below this share of total the verdict reads 'large sync, light protocol touch'). These affect wording only, never paging.

chain-runtime-upgrade._comment: Class order is delivery priority: a live chain upgrade surfaces before repo alerts in the same scan.

chain-parameter-change._comment: Root-settable chain-parameter transitions (change: network-drift-443). DISABLED at ship time — enable together with livedata chain_params.enabled at deploy, and seed this class's watermark first so the seeded observations cannot backfill-flood. Reads livedata's chain_param_events read-only past a row-id watermark. Instant tier, priority just below chain upgrades. NO cooldown and no digest by design: a knob like the Root Reborn curation switch cannot burst, and suppressing a second flip would be the wrong failure. `governs` maps an item to the one-line description rendered in the body (escaped like every other value).

governs.EmissionBarRank: emission gate bar selection: N > 0 pins the bar to the Nth largest demand share, N = 0 falls back to the q-mass quantile
governs.EmissionBarQuantile: q-mass bar value, applied only when the bar rank is 0
governs.EmissionGateExponent: gate sharpness: how hard emission collapses below the bar
governs.RootWeightSettingEnabled: Root Reborn basket curation master switch: while false every fund runs the null strategy and root dividends accumulate in place
governs.RootWeightsCap: root basket concentration cap: the largest share of a root weight vector one destination may take (4096 of 65535 is 1/16, so a curated basket spreads across at least 16 destinations)

subnet-registry._comment: Netuid set and chain-name changes between consecutive panel snapshots (change: pulse-briefing). The first snapshot seeds silently; a registration, deregistration, or on-chain rename pages at instant tier.
subnet-registry._tier_comment: DEMOTED to briefing 2026-09-09 (change: rotation-signal-gate). All six alerts in the preceding 30 days were `renamed`: a subnet changing its display name has no action behind it. Registration and deregistration still ride the daily briefing. Flip back to instant to roll back.

fail-closed._comment: One page per outage when the gate poll or the chain-parameter watch has recorded only failures for longer than window_hours (change: pulse-briefing). Keyed by the outage's first failure so a persisting outage never pages twice; recovery re-arms the key.

gate-crossing._comment: Emission-gate crossing alerts (change: gate-crossing-signal). DISABLED at ship time — enable together with livedata gate_signal.enabled at deploy (the whole rollback is flipping both back). Reads livedata's gate_events read-only past a row-id watermark. Instant tier, priority just below chain upgrades; cooldown_hours dampens per-netuid paging (suppressed events are recorded in the ledger, never dropped).

fleet-signal._comment: Fleet-signals queue (change: fleet-signals): narrative-cluster / watchlist / econ-code instant alerts + durable signal digest lines from the fleet store, read STRICTLY read-only. Priority below chain upgrades, above subtensor repo alerts. digest_backstop_hours flushes pending digest lines as a standalone summary when no instant alert rides them.

root-rotation._comment: Shifts in where curated root dividends point (change: rotation-signal-gate). SHADOW on introduction: events are recorded and measured in the effectiveness ledger but nothing is sent, so the class accrues evidence before it can ever page. Promote to instant only against a filled 7-day ledger read that beats the fleet baseline, and record that decision in docs/decisions.md.

econ-code._comment: DEMOTED 2026-09-09 on its own effectiveness read: at n=212 (1d) and n=185 (7d) the class median was -0.278% vs a -0.305% fleet baseline at one day and -2.175% vs -1.873% at seven, so no edge at one day and worse than baseline at seven. Detection, the econ judge, the cooldown and the ledger all continue: the 30-day horizon is still half-pending and is the only thing that could reverse this. Flip back to instant to roll back.

narrative-cluster._comment: Unchanged. n=9 at the 1d horizon is too small to read either way; it stays instant until its own sample is readable.

watchlist._comment: Unchanged and operator-curated: these terms were chosen by hand, so the class carries intent that the ledger cannot see. n=3.

_tier_comment: Every class carries a delivery tier (change: pulse-briefing): instant pages on the scan that finds the event; briefing records the event as `briefed`, advances the watermark, and surfaces it only through the pulse briefing. Ships with every class instant (today's behaviour); the planned demotion to briefing tier for econ-code/gate-crossing/repository-update/fleet-signal/schema-drift/knowledge-ingestion is one config commit, and flipping a tier back is the rollback.

briefing._comment: Pulse briefing (change: pulse-briefing): a daily edition at daily_hour_utc, replaced by a weekly edition on weekly_weekday (Python weekday: Monday 0 .. Sunday 6). Composed ONLY from stores already on disk, read-only: no provider call, no model call. Edition watermarks live in the notifier ledger, so a restart cannot double-send and a missed hour catches up on the next scan that day. Figures persist per edition for deltas. Truncation drops whole lines from the lowest-priority section upward; the network section is never cut. Rollback: enabled false stops editions and touches nothing else.
